MATHEMATICS — MOCK EXAM #1
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 156
   B. 48
   C. 144
   D. 24

2. Which fraction is equivalent to 6/8? (1 mark)
   A. 3/4
   B. 1/2
   C. 2/3
   D. 1/4

3. What is 4 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 12
   C. 1
   D. 13

4. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 90
   B. 36
   C. 81
   D. 18

5. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 12x
   B. 6x
   C. 6x + 2
   D. 12x + 2

6. In the number 3147, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 400
   C. 40
   D. 10

7. What is √16? (1 mark)
   A. 8
   B. 16
   C. 4
   D. 5

8. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 6 cm and 8 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 14
   B. 12
   C. 10
   D. 2

9. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 49
   B. 2
   C. 1
   D. 1

10. Which is greater: 1/4 or 2/2? (1 mark)
   A. They are equal
   B. 1/4
   C. Cannot tell
   D. 2/2

11. In the number 3547, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 10
   B. 400
   C. 40
   D. 4

12. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 11
   B. 121
   C. 22
   D. 122

13. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 4 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 30
   B. 15
   C. 22
   D. 44

14. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 31
   B. 31.6
   C. 37
   D. 31.7

15. Solve for x: x + 5 = 13. (1 mark)
   A. 13
   B. 5
   C. 9
   D. 8

16. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 19.6
   C. 19.7
   D. 19

17. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 42
   B. 12
   C. 24
   D. 36

18. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 4 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 19
   B. 60
   C. 30
   D. 38

19. What is the square of 9? (1 mark)
   A. 9
   B. 82
   C. 18
   D. 81

20. What is 1/4 as a decimal? (1 mark)
   A. 2.5
   B. 0.025
   C. 0.25
   D. 0.205

21. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 5
   B. 25
   C. 10
   D. 26

22. What is 4 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 32
   B. 12
   C. 33
   D. 4

23. What is 8 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 17
   B. 72
   C. 73
   D. 1

24. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 21
   B. 15.7
   C. 15.6
   D. 15

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
25. Show full working: A trader sells 18 items at Ksh 50 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

26. Show full working: A trader sells 19 items at Ksh 55 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

31. Show full working: A trader sells 16 items at Ksh 80 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)

32. Show full working: A trader sells 17 items at Ksh 85 each. Find the total money collected. (4 marks)
